name: 侠客行一百
english_description: A branch from the "Xiamen Hotline 100" site, MudOS V22pre11. Despite sharing a title with this project's xkx100 (also "Ode to Gallantry 100"), this is a genuinely different, smaller snapshot (6,456 vs. 14,255 .lpc files, with a different directory layout including ftp/mudos.etc/www directories absent from xkx100), not a duplicate archive. Its map and sect roster lean closer to a "standard" configuration — Huashan, Wudang, Shaolin, the Beggars' Sect, Emei, the Ming Cult, and the cities around Chang'an — more compact than xkx100's sprawling cross-border map. Comments in its bundled HTTP daemon note it was "modified to the ES2 mudlib base by xiaobao@XAJH," and another file marks its version as "MudOS v22.1b20, XAJH mudlib 2.0b," pointing to an earlier codebase branch known as "XAJH mudlib" rather than a direct descendant of xkx100's core code.
